opening.argument: The presentation promotes Forsage BUSD as a refer-and-earn opportunity and links daily earnings to promoting the system. It asks participants to invite 200–300 people and message their groups, while associating results within about 30 days with system promotion and related activities. The speaker also places earnings in the context of an upline and instructs participants to bring others into the business. These features establish a recruitment-based commission structure with tiered incentives, rather than an independently demonstrated source of income. The material does not establish actual earnings or transaction outcomes, and the instruction not to cheat anyone does not verify the earnings claims.
